summary: Iteration 5 (Admin Search + Bulk Actions) fully verified. 41/41 pytest tests pass across all 4 backend test files, including 10 new tests in test_meridian_bulk.py covering auth-required, valid bulk confirm (matched=2/modified=2 + DB verified), invalid status (400 'Invalid status.'), empty ids (422), >200 ids (422), all-nonexistent ids (200 matched=0), mixed valid+nonexistent, already-at-target (matched=2 modified=1), and regression PATCH single (status-only + notes-only). Frontend UI on preview URL: login OK; admin-search-bar + admin-search-input visible; search 'grace' → '1 of 4', matches notes ('sleep-tracking' → 1 of 4) and message ('Rash' → 1 of 4); empty-state text 'No matches for "zzzzzzzzz".'; admin-search-clear resets query. Bulk: checkbox per card (select-<id>) works, admin-bulk-bar appears on 1+ selection with correct testids (bulk-select-all/bulk-clear/bulk-confirm/bulk-cancel + count '4 selected'); Select-all-visible combines with search (only currently-filtered rows selected); Confirm-all POST /api/admin/appointments/bulk with status=confirmed → status pill switches to Confirmed, selection clears, bulk bar hides; Cancel-all sets 4 filtered rows to Cancelled — no 429 rate-limit hit (bulk endpoint separate from public creation). Mobile 390x844: no horizontal overflow, search bar + bulk bar wrap cleanly. Grace Reyes demo appointment restored (status=requested, notes preserved); all bulk_/TEST_ data + booking_attempts + login_attempts collections cleaned. Final appointments count = 1 (Grace only).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: BulkStatusIn.status is a plain str (not Enum) — validated at handler with VALID_STATUSES; works fine but a Literal['requested','confirmed','cancelled'] would give 422 at pydantic layer and free OpenAPI enum. Minor.

server.py: admin_bulk_update does not verify how many ids were unknown vs already-at-target — response only exposes matched/modified. Frontend currently doesn't need it, but a future 'not_found' count could be helpful.

server.py: bulk endpoint has no rate limit, which is correct for authenticated admin, but ids max_length=200 is the only guardrail; a huge malformed $in list could still be expensive if abused with duplicates. Acceptable.

Admin.tsx bulkUpdate: optimistic UI updates statuses locally then reloads on success; on failure it rolls back — good. However there is no visible user-facing error toast on failure; consider surfacing 'Bulk update failed' inline like exportCsv issue noted in iter4.

Admin.tsx filter+search combined logic: `filtered` recomputes correctly via useMemo; selectAllVisible correctly reads `filtered`. Selection state persists across search changes (an id can remain selected even if hidden). This is safe because bulkUpdate acts on `selected` regardless of visibility, but could confuse users. Consider auto-pruning selection when items leave the filter, or showing a subtle 'N selected (M hidden)' hint.

Admin.tsx: keyboard accessibility — bulk checkbox is a <button> with aria-pressed (good), but the whole admin-card is not a focus stop; Space/Enter on the row does nothing. Fine as-is since the checkbox is focusable.
index.css: .admin-card.is-selected cyan-forest inset bar is only a left border; consider a subtle background tint for higher contrast on selection state, but current design matches the palette.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral: 3 UI-seed appointments (Alice/Bob/Cara with distinct notes+messages) inserted directly via pymongo for bulk UI testing, plus 9 test_meridian_bulk.py seed docs via pymongo. All bulk_/TEST_ prefixed docs + booking_attempts + login_attempts cleared at end. Grace Reyes restored to status=requested with notes='Bring sleep-tracking data. Discuss Rx options.'. Final appointments count = 1.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Four backend test files under /app/backend/tests/: test_meridian_api.py, test_meridian_admin.py, test_meridian_csv_notes.py, test_meridian_bulk.py. Run all with: `set -a; source /app/frontend/.env; source /app/backend/.env; set +a; cd /app && python -m pytest backend/tests/ -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/iter{N}_results.xml`. All 41 tests self-clean bulk_/TEST_/hp_/rl_/csv_/notes_-prefixed data. IMPORTANT: when seeding bulk-test data for UI, insert via pymongo — the public POST /api/appointments has a 5/hour/IP rate limit that would trip the login-lockout brute-force test as well if abused. The bulk endpoint POST /api/admin/appointments/bulk itself has NO rate limit (admin-authed) and uses ids min_length=1 max_length=200 pydantic bounds → 422 for out-of-range.
